issues.title: eval: implement layered request/extraction/semantic benchmark accounting
issues.body: Adopt ADR-0005. Replace failed-as-all-missed accounting, use expected-null hallucination opportunities, add strict document success and numerator/denominator reporting. Supersedes the executable work in #46.

issues.title: eval: surface terminal validation spend and include it in run economics
issues.body: Expose finite nonnegative cost_usd on billed terminal 422 responses and carry it through journal/summary/report. Retitle or supersede #57, whose other items have landed.

issues.title: eval: durable run manifest, append-only journal and hash-safe resume
issues.body: Implement ADR-0006 so a paid interruption cannot discard prior results and report provenance is reconstructable.

issues.title: eval: classify infrastructure, ambiguous-sent and provider failures
issues.body: Ratify and implement ADR-0007. Move remaining transport-policy work from #74 here, then close the historical omnibus.

issues.title: fixtures: import and review stratified synthetic DRAFT corpus
issues.body: Import the bundle candidate fixtures as DRAFT only, generate a coverage sidecar, and prepare low-to-high ambiguity human review batches. This is the fixture half of #79.

issues.title: fixtures: source and provenance-review real-anonymized invoice/job corpora
issues.body: Fill real-world strata, anonymise and record provenance/licence review. No agent may self-certify REVIEWED ground truth.

issues.title: eval: test-only full-corpus ASGI rehearsal with perfect and failure maps
issues.body: Implement the rehearsal half of #79 without adding a production expected-label echo path. Cover perfect, error, interruption, resume and mixed-identity cases.

issues.title: schema(job): reject negative salary values and blank strings before baseline
issues.body: Split from #80. Decide and, if approved, apply targeted job v1 tightening without whitespace/value coercion.

issues.title: cleanup: either wire normalize.py into explicit label tooling or remove it
issues.body: Split from #80. Green tests for unwired code are false confidence. Prefer deletion unless a named label-authoring workflow consumes the module.

issues.title: agent-harness: prove PreToolUse wiring, pin floor digests and gate the canonical matrix
issues.body: Rewrite #88 for current main. Verify whether a global adapter wires the floor, add portable provenance and avoid running the expensive matrix on unrelated PRs.

issues.title: docs: establish canonical project-state facts and drift checks
issues.body: Reconcile STATUS/PLAN/ADR/CLAUDE/README and make volatile facts generated or checked rather than repeated manually.

issues.title: release: publish measured v0.1.0 with report, manifest and journal-derived summary
issues.body: Pilot, full frozen run, outlier review, public-claim approval and formal release. No paid action without explicit run approval.

issues.title: gate: promote human-approved extract-api baseline and compare regressions
issues.body: Implement ADR-0009 and a cheap canary/full-release cadence. Thresholds must be derived from measured data/variance.

issues.title: ops: gateway-only external deployment, request IDs, structured logs and container limits
issues.body: Do not expose the current unauthenticated Compose service directly. Add gateway runbook, correlation IDs, redacted logs and untrusted-PDF resource controls.
